qualification.education_qualification: BE/BTech in Mechanical Engineering with 02 years of experience OR BE/BTech in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering with MEP/HVAC courses (duration not less than 6 months) and 02 years of experience OR Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 04 years of experience OR Diploma in Electrical Engineering with MEP/HVAC courses (duration not less than 6 months) and 04 years of experience.
qualification.details: Support Engineer (HVAC): BE/BTech in Mechanical Engineering with 02 years of experience in projects/operations/maintenance of HVAC systems. OR BE/BTech in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Electronics Engineering with MEP/HVAC courses (duration not less than 6 months) and 02 years of experience in projects/operations/maintenance of HVAC systems. OR Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 04 years of experience in projects/operations/maintenance of HVAC systems. OR Diploma in Electrical Engineering with MEP/HVAC courses (duration not less than 6 months) and 04 years of experience in projects/operations/maintenance of HVAC systems.

salary_details.details: Rs.24,300/- per month (including Rs.300/- towards telephone allowance).

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Kozhikode Support Engineer (HVAC) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Kozhikode to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Support Engineer (HVAC) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Support Engineer (HVAC) post at IIM Kozhikode is 12th October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Support Engineer (HVAC) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BE/BTech in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering with relevant HVAC courses, or a Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering with relevant HVAC courses, along with specified years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Support Engineer (HVAC) post is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Support Engineer (HVAC) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 24,300/- per month, which includes a telephone allowance of Rs. 300/-.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Support Engineer (HVAC) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Support Engineer (HVAC) position at IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of IIM Kozhikode.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Support Engineer (HVAC) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Support Engineer (HVAC) position?
faq.answer: The Support Engineer (HVAC) position is on a contract basis.

faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
